channel.title: Zone of Mac - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Zone of Mac (zoneofmac.com)

item.title: Tired of Your iPhone Buzzing Nonstop? Focus Modes Fix That
item.description: Apple built a notification filter into every iPhone that silences distractions, syncs across all your devices, and reshapes your Lock Screen automatically. Most people have never opened it.

item.title: Stop Burying Your HomePod Mini in a Corner
item.description: A room-by-room placement guide that fixes the most common HomePod mini sound problems — and improves Siri microphone performance while you're at it.

item.title: Every Mac That Supports macOS Tahoe and What You Actually Get
item.description: macOS Tahoe runs on Apple Silicon and four Intel Macs, but the feature gap between them is wider than Apple admits. Full compatibility list with Apple Intelligence status for every model.

item.title: Stop Watering Your Lawn on a Dumb Timer
item.description: HomeKit sprinkler controllers bring your yard into Apple Home with Siri voice control, smart automations, and weather-aware scheduling. Here are the three that actually work.

item.title: Your iPhone Screen Recordings Look Better Now — Here is What Changed
item.description: iOS 26 removed the resolution cap and added HDR to screen recording. This guide walks through setup, the new settings, and the details Apple did not highlight.

item.title: That Hidden macOS Recovery Mode Can Save Your Mac
item.description: macOS Recovery gives you Disk Utility, Terminal, password resets, and a full reinstall toolkit. This guide covers every startup option on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, plus the new Device Recovery Assistant in macOS Tahoe.

item.title: The Complete Parent's Guide to Apple Watch Family Setup
item.description: Everything you need to configure a cellular Apple Watch as a safe, independent device for your child — from carrier activation to the hidden Schooltime unlock report.

item.title: Every iPhone Air Sacrifice Apple Made for That 5.6mm Design
item.description: The iPhone Air's 5.6mm titanium frame hides real sacrifices in camera versatility, battery capacity, USB speed, and spatial video. See what Apple traded away.

item.title: Apple TV 4K WiFi vs Ethernet — Which Model Actually Belongs in Your Living Room?
item.description: The cheap Apple TV 4K upgrade adds Gigabit Ethernet, 128GB storage, and Thread networking. Here is exactly who needs it and who can skip it.

item.title: Three Apple Watch Faces With Actual 3D Depth Effects
item.description: watchOS 26 hides layered depth, live 3D globes, and Liquid Glass animation in faces most owners scroll past. This guide shows you how to unlock all three.
